FieldVmessEncryption: VMess encryption (auto by default; V4 only)
FieldVmessAlterId: VMess alterId (0 / AEAD by default; V4 only)
FieldPinnedCertificate: Pinned certificate chain SHA256 (Base64; not supported for HY2)
ToggleAllowInsecureTls: V4 TLS: allowInsecure (skips certificate verification; high risk)
HelpAllowInsecureTls: Disabled by default. Available in V4 for legacy servers only. Keep it off for Certbot / Let's Encrypt certificates; V5 does not emit this setting.
HelpTransportParameters: Only fields relevant to the selected transport are displayed.
FieldCoreRoutingMode: Core routing policy (independent of system proxy)
HelpRestoreWindowsProxy: Restore previous Windows proxy settings when disconnected or exiting. Manual mode does not modify system settings.
HelpPacRuleBuilder: PAC decides whether applications send traffic into the proxy. Core routing decides the outbound after entering V2Ray. Explicit direct rules override explicit proxy; explicit proxy can override template sites.
HelpGeoDataScope: Geo data routes traffic that has already entered v2ray-core; PAC uses independent JavaScript rules.
HelpBypassChinaRules: Smart routing: explicit PAC proxy sites first; private/local and China domains/IPs direct; remaining traffic proxied.
ToggleUseCustomConfig: Use external JSON config (format follows V4 / V5 selection)
HelpSensitiveConfig: Configs may contain UUIDs and passwords. Do not share them publicly.
HelpPacViewer: Read-only preview. Edit domain rules under Routing & PAC.
HelpConnectTooltip: Connect the selected server and apply the chosen Windows proxy mode
PlaceholderServerAddress: Server hostname or IP, e.g. server.example.com
PlaceholderRouteSetName: Rule set name, e.g. Bypass China
HelpGlobalSettingsShared: These settings are shared when switching servers
HelpProxySettingsShared: Local ports, system proxy mode, DNS and app behavior apply to every server, even after switching.
HelpRoutingSettingsShared: PAC templates, GeoIP / GeoSite and routing rules are shared across servers, independently of transport options.
HelpVisualRouting: Rules are matched from top to bottom; the first matching rule wins. Rules apply to every server but only to traffic already entering V2Ray.
HelpVisualRoutingSave: Save the rule set after editing. Unrepresented advanced fields remain in the raw JSON.
RoutingNoRules: No rules yet. Add a rule to get started.
RoutingBuiltInReadonly: Built-in policies are read-only. To select or change the effective routing policy, use Proxy settings.
RoutingProxyAllDefault: No explicit rules. All traffic entering the core uses the first proxy outbound (proxy).
RoutingDirectDefault: Matches all TCP/UDP traffic and sends it to the direct outbound.
RoutingNoRuleSet: No custom rule set yet. Select New rule set, then Add rule.
RoutingNoRulesNext: No rules yet. Select Add rule, fill in the conditions, then Apply changes.
RoutingRulePriorityHelp: Top-down, first match wins. Select a rule to edit; use Move up/down to reorder.
RoutingNewRuleDraft: New rule draft: specify a domain, IP or port condition and select Apply changes to save.
HelpDomainStrategy: AsIs: match domains only; IPIfNonMatch: resolve IP after no domain match; IPOnDemand: resolve at IP rules.
HelpRoutingDomains: Match hostnames. domain:example.com matches the domain and subdomains; geosite:cn reads geosite.dat.
HelpRoutingIps: Match destination IPs. geoip:cn is Mainland China; geoip:private is private networks; CIDR is supported.
HelpRoutingAndConditions: Domain AND IP fields must both match. To express OR, create two separate rules.
RoutingChooseRule: Select a rule from the list or click Add rule.
RoutingRuleNeedsCondition: Provide at least a domain, IP or port condition to avoid an accidental catch-all rule.
RoutingManagedPacOnly: PAC integration uses managed proxy/direct website lists only. Custom PAC JavaScript is not parsed. Core routing applies only to traffic entering V2Ray.
HelpPacWebsiteComments: One website per line. Lines starting with // are comments and are ignored by PAC and core routing. Inline notes after a space and // are also supported.
DisconnectBeforeDelete: This server is part of the running connection. Disconnect before deleting it.
RunningNodeEditLocked: This server is in the running configuration. Disconnect before editing or deleting it. Other servers remain editable.
DisconnectBeforeEdit: Disconnect the current proxy connection first.
CoreManualCheckPrompt: Click “Check for core updates” to check versions manually.
CoreCustomPathCannotInstall: Custom core path is selected. In-app installation supports only VelaRay/v2ray-core/; you can still check versions manually.
CoreUpToDate: You have the latest release for the selected update channel.
CoreDisconnectToInstall: An update is available. Disconnect the running proxy before installing.
CoreUpdateAvailable: A newer release is available to download and install.
CoreInstallConfirmation: Download {0} from the official V2Fly repository, verify SHA256 and version, and back up the previous executable? Disconnect before installation.
CoreDownloadingAndVerifying: Downloading, verifying and installing the core. Do not connect yet…
CoreInstallSuccess: Core updated successfully. You can reconnect.
CoreUpdateDescription: VelaRay requests the official V2Fly GitHub Releases only after you click “Check for core updates”; it never checks automatically at startup or when the release channel changes. Downloads are SHA256-verified and replace only the core executable.
CorePathChangedRecheck: Core path changed. Check for updates again.
HelpSmartUnmatchedRoute: Smart mode only. Explicit direct, private and China rules take precedence. Reconnect for this change to affect a running connection.
SmartManagedPacNotice: Smart unmatched → Proxy only affects traffic that already reaches V2Ray. It never overrides the PAC template. With PAC Direct by default, unlisted sites stay direct; with Proxy by default, unlisted sites are sent to the local proxy unless explicitly bypassed.
HelpPacSubdomains: Domain rules automatically match the root and every subdomain: google.com matches www.google.com and a.b.google.com, but not notgoogle.com.
HelpTestTcpLatency: Measure TCP connect time; UDP transports such as Hysteria2 are not measured
RoutingPendingReconnectHint: Changes saved; the running core still uses the previous routing configuration. Reconnect to apply.
RoutingPendingPacDeferred: PAC domain changes are saved but not live. Reconnect to update PAC and core together.
ManagedPacRawLocked: Do not overwrite managed.pac while Smart routing is active. Use the PAC template or create a custom PAC file.
HelpProxyModeCards: Choose how Windows system proxy is configured. Saving never disconnects or restarts an active connection.
ProxyModePacDescription: Uses a local PAC script to decide which requests go direct or through the proxy.
ProxyModeGlobalDescription: Configures Windows HTTP/HTTPS and SOCKS5 proxy settings; this is not TUN.
ProxyModeManualDescription: Runs local SOCKS5/HTTP ports without changing Windows system proxy settings.
ProxyInboundHttpDescription: For applications that honor system proxy settings or manual configuration.
HelpApplyRoutingRuleSet: Only this button promotes the selected rule definition to the next core configuration. Use Reconnect and apply to update a running connection.
RoutingRuleAppliedStatus: Selected: {0}. Editing a rule does not replace this applied version.
RoutingRuleNotAppliedStatus: No custom rule set has been applied yet.
RoutingRuleMissingStatus: The selected rule set was removed from the editor; its applied snapshot is preserved until you select a replacement.
HelpRoutingEditorNotApplied: This page only views and edits rules. To choose or update the active strategy, select and apply it in Proxy settings.
RoutingRuleSnapshotSaved: Selected rule snapshot saved. Reconnect to apply it to the core.
RoutingBuiltInAllHelp: Browse every built-in policy and its match order. Previews cannot be edited or activated here; choose the active policy under Proxy settings.
RoutingBuiltInJsonPlaceholder: Select a built-in policy above to preview its read-only JSON
RoutingBuiltInJsonFormat: {0} · Example generated for the selected node’s config version; not the running configuration.
RoutingBuiltInJsonError: Could not generate built-in routing preview.
RoutingCustomDraftsTitle: Custom routing rules (edit and save only)
